subtitle.zh: 从一个请求，看见整个系统
subtitle.en: See the system through one request

description.zh: 沿着文章与真实源码，用十二篇交互讲解理解 Super-agent 的架构、协作、实验依据和开放问题。
description.en: Follow the article and real source through twelve interactive lessons on Super-agent architecture, collaboration, experimental evidence, and open questions.

title.zh: 一个 Agent，为什么需要多个 Session？
title.en: Why does one agent need several sessions?

description.zh: 切换三种组织方式，观察跨渠道连续性与并发执行如何相互制约。
description.en: Switch between three designs to inspect continuity across channels and concurrency across tasks.

title.en: Which path does a message take?

description.zh: 切换四种事件，逐步观察过滤、Router 与订阅透传。
description.en: Compare four events through filtering, the Router, and subscription pass-through.

title.zh: Router 为什么没有被消息淹没？
title.en: Why is the Router not overwhelmed?

description.zh: 调节事件到达量与合批上限，观察队列；再对照原文的真实测量端点。
description.en: Adjust arrivals and batch capacity, inspect the queue, then compare the article’s measured endpoints.

title.zh: 上下文如何沿引用找回来

description.zh: Inline & Spill 与 Chain of Recall。
description.en: Inline & Spill and Chain of Recall.

title.zh: 用户还没下指令，可以先做什么？
title.en: What can an agent prepare before being asked?

description.zh: 切换主动接单模式与调查结果，观察何时执行、何时只记录、何时安静结束。
description.en: Switch acceptance mode and investigation outcome to see when work runs, is only recorded, or ends quietly.

title.zh: 任务还在跑，指令已经到
title.en: Keep talking while a task runs

description.zh: 异步 ReAct 如何缩短前台等待。
description.en: How asynchronous ReAct reduces foreground waiting.

title.zh: 同一件事，群聊和 PR 应该怎样表达？
title.en: How should the same work appear in chat and a PR?

description.zh: 切换渠道与任务方向；对话窗口改变，任务身份和执行记录仍连续。
description.en: Switch channel and task direction. The conversation surface changes while task identity and execution records remain continuous.

title.zh: Agent 在云端，为什么还能操作我的电脑？
title.en: How can a cloud agent work on my computer?

description.zh: 拆开推理计算、持久状态和执行环境，再模拟设备离线与 Loop 重启。
description.en: Separate inference compute, durable state, and execution environments, then simulate device disconnection and a Loop restart.

title.zh: 进程停止后，工作如何继续
title.en: Keep work going after a process stops

description.zh: 持久化、执行环境与外部 Watchdog 的边界。
description.en: Persistence, execution environments, and the limits of an external Watchdog.

title.en: What do the experiments actually establish?

description.zh: 比较四种实验设计的延迟和 cache-read tokens，辨别收益、代价与证据边界。
description.en: Compare latency and cache-read tokens across four designs, separating benefits, tradeoffs, and evidence limits.

title.zh: 哪些上下文共享，哪些必须隔离？
title.en: Which context is shared, and which is isolated?

description.zh: 切换共享实例、Router 分片和独立实例，观察信息可见性与协调路径。
description.en: Switch between a shared instance, Router shards, and separate instances to inspect information visibility and coordination.

title.zh: 外部消息如何影响执行设备？
title.en: How can an external message affect execution devices?

description.zh: 追踪不可信输入到工具执行的路径，比较权限约束与不暴露凭据分别解决什么。
description.en: Trace untrusted input to tool execution and compare what permission constraints and opaque credential use each address.
